welcome.headline: Promo Preflight
welcome.positioning: Internal promo & CRM ops workspace for pre-launch review
welcome.body: Start from a sample case or a live campaign bundle, run the check, review blockers, save the run, prepare handoff copy, and compare versions without changing the existing workflow.
welcome.ctaHint: Use a sample case to follow the demo path from Intake to Risk Report, Campaigns, version diff, and handoff.
welcome.workflowSubtitle: From loading a campaign bundle to comparing versions

workflowPreview.label: Load a sample case or campaign bundle
workflowPreview.description: Start the demo with realistic promo, CRM, and launch-review inputs

workflowPreview.label: Run the check
workflowPreview.description: 8 checks review the bundle before the Risk Report opens

workflowPreview.label: Review blockers
workflowPreview.description: Risk Report shows what blocks launch and who needs to act

workflowPreview.label: Save the run & prepare the handoff

steps.title: Start on the landing screen
steps.description: Open the internal Promo Preflight workspace and launch the walkthrough from a synthetic demo flow.

steps.title: Load a sample case
steps.description: Screen 02 / Campaign bundle opens with sample cases so the walkthrough starts from a realistic synthetic CRM review scenario.

steps.title: Run the check
steps.description: From Screen 02, run 8 offline checks across the bundle and move straight into the Risk Report.

steps.title: Review the Risk Report
steps.description: Screen 03 / Risk Report ranks blockers, warnings, and clean checks so the next operational decision is obvious.

steps.title: Save the review run
steps.description: Save the current report as an internal review run before moving into Campaigns, version history, and handoff.

steps.title: Open Campaigns
steps.description: Screen 01 / Campaigns shows saved runs, latest readiness state, and the path into version history for the same campaign.

steps.title: Compare versions
steps.description: Version detail and diff highlight what was fixed, reopened, or newly introduced between saved review runs.

steps.title: Prepare the handoff update
steps.description: Screen 04 / Handoff turns the saved report into a Slack-ready internal Promo/CRM Ops update for launch owners.

exampleDescriptions.EX01: Welcome bonus audit: email says 100% / €500 while offer basics say 50% / €300
exampleDescriptions.EX02: Welcome bonus terms sweep: terms are too short and max-bet wording is missing
exampleDescriptions.EX03: Cashback reconciliation: max cashout (€100) is lower than max bonus (€200)
exampleDescriptions.EX04: UK freebet copy review: UKGC-like geo with "guaranteed outcome" and no responsible-gambling wording
exampleDescriptions.EX05: Brazil reactivation: pt-BR locale is paired with EUR and ambiguous dates
exampleDescriptions.EX06: VIP reload approval gate: only the product owner is assigned, so approval roles are missing
exampleDescriptions.EX07: Weekend tournament QA: CTA URL has no scheme, so the link is invalid
exampleDescriptions.EX08: Weekend free spins push: push title exceeds the 55-character hard limit
exampleDescriptions.EX09: Brazil welcome audit: missing responsible-gambling wording, GEO terms, and max-bet terms
exampleDescriptions.EX10: EU free spins audit: missing eligible games wording and age wording
exampleDescriptions.EX11: VIP cashback audit: missing eligibility rules and the percentage claims do not match

issueDetail.title: Issue detail

issueDetail.whyDefault: Clean this up before handoff so launch owners have clear, traceable actions.
